correctness.rationale: For centered circumradius-one icosahedron and dodecahedron, half-width is max_{vertices v} U·v by antipodal symmetry. Their spherical Voronoi cells are regular pentagons (12) and triangles (20), each inscribed about cap of angular apothem a and covering radius b; geometry gives the same minimum support r=sqrt((5+2sqrt(5))/15). For cap threshold r<=t<=1, disjoint side overshoot segments before the Voronoi vertices have integral B(t;c), yielding survival N(1-t)/2−15 B(t;c)/pi, with c_I~.85065 and c_D~.93417. The proof checks aperture derivative H'(r)=0, H'>0 until c_I, then no interior minimum and positive endpoint, then exact H=4(1-t) above c_D. It also derives quadratic lower onset and exactly linear upper tails. Independent 80000-direction per-solid quasiuniform evaluations agreed with survival formulas at six thresholds to <0.00017 and strict stochastic order at 199 test thresholds; these are corroboration only, not the all-threshold proof.
